chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Perform the funeral prayer over the one stoned from my Ummah and over the one who killed himself from my Ummah, and do not leave anyone from my Ummah without funeral prayer."

key_terms.أُمَّتِي: My community; the Muslim Ummah of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْمَرْجُومِ: The one who was stoned as a legal punishment
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ: Prayer; here specifically the funeral prayer
key_terms.صَلُّوا: Perform the prayer; here it means to offer the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Should the funeral prayer be offered for a Muslim who was stoned or who took his own life?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that salat al-janazah is to be performed for members of the Prophet’s Ummah even if they died through grave sin or self-killing. It emphasizes maintaining the communal funeral rites for Muslims and not excluding them from this prayer.
